item.description: Jazz, a market and a late rave.

item.content:encoded:
This weekend brings jazz on the lawn, a makers market and a very late rave.

This Weekend’s Highlights

🎷 Catch Sunset Jazz on the Lawn on Friday.

FRIDAY, OCTOBER 23

Sunset Jazz on the Lawn

Concert

A relaxed evening of jazz standards under the trees, with a picnic feel.

📍 Where: Freedom Park, Lagos Island

🗓 When: Friday, October 23 • 6 PM

🎟 Tickets: ₦5,000

Click here to Buy Tickets

SATURDAY, OCTOBER 24

Makers Market

Market

Local designers, food stalls and live music all afternoon.

📍 Where: Muri Okunola Park, Victoria Island

🗓 When: Saturday, October 24 • 11 AM to 6 PM

🎟 Tickets: Free entry

Neon Basement Rave

Rave

House and techno until sunrise.

📍 Where: The Basement, Oniru

🗓 When: Saturday, October 24 • 10 PM

🎟 Tickets: ₦15,000

Get a ticket here

SUNDAY, OCTOBER 25

Quiet Book Swap

Bring a book, take a book.

📍 Where: Paper Cafe, Yaba

🗓 When: Sunday, October 25 • 2 PM
